info.title: MS Paint - Computer Use Agent Skill
info.description: Instructions for a computer use agent to interact with Microsoft Paint on Windows via screenshot-based pixel coordination.

steps: Click the search bar on the taskbar
Type 'paint'
Click 'Paint' in the search results (classic Paint, not Paint 3D)
If the canvas isn't fully visible, maximize the window
Take ONE screenshot to confirm Paint is open and note canvas coordinates

visualCues.canvas: Large white rectangle in the center of the window

post.summary: Select a drawing tool from the ribbon

ribbonLayout.description: Ribbon sections left-to-right: Clipboard → Image → Tools → Brushes → Shapes → Size → Colors

dropdowns.outline: Controls border style — Solid color, No outline, etc.
dropdowns.fill: Controls interior — No fill, Solid color, etc.

x-agent-instructions.howToSelect: Single-click the tool icon. Do NOT screenshot to verify — trust your click and proceed immediately to the next action.
x-agent-instructions.trustRule: Tool selections are reliable UI operations. NEVER take a screenshot to verify a tool was selected.

rules: Use ONLY the 30 swatches in the palette grid — NEVER click 'Edit colors'
If Edit Colors dialog opens accidentally, press Escape IMMEDIATELY
Color selections are reliable — NEVER take a screenshot to verify a color was set

standardSwatchLocations.topRow: black, white, light gray, gray, dark red, red, orange, yellow, light green, green
standardSwatchLocations.middleRow: darker/muted variants — brown is left-center area, dark green is right area
standardSwatchLocations.bottomRow: light/pastel variants — light blue is bottom row, right side

post.summary: Fill an enclosed area with a solid color

steps: Click the Fill (bucket) icon in the Tools section
Left-click the desired color swatch to set Color 1
Click once inside the target area on the canvas
x-agent-instructions.warning: Target area MUST be completely enclosed. If color leaks, press Ctrl+Z immediately.

setup: 1. Click the desired shape icon in the Shapes section
2. Left-click a color swatch for Color 1 (outline)
3. Right-click a color swatch for Color 2 (fill)
4. Set the Outline dropdown (Solid color or No outline)
5. Set the Fill dropdown (Solid color or No fill)
6. Optionally set thickness via Size dropdown
drawing: Click outside the shape to finalize it
x-agent-instructions.batchingRule: When drawing multiple similar shapes (e.g., 4 legs, multiple windows): select tool and set colors ONCE, then draw ALL shapes in sequence without clicking outside between each one. Click outside only after the final shape. Do NOT screenshot between individual shapes.
tips: Hold Shift to constrain proportions (circle, square)
Once you click outside, the shape is permanent — use Ctrl+Z to undo if wrong

steps: Click the Text tool (A icon) in Tools section
Click-and-drag to create a text box
Type your text
Click outside to commit — text becomes permanent pixels
x-agent-instructions.warning: Text cannot be edited after clicking outside. If wrong, press Ctrl+Z immediately.

steps: Click the Eraser icon in the Tools section
Select eraser size from the Size dropdown
Click-and-drag over the area to erase
x-agent-instructions.note: Eraser replaces pixels with Color 2 (default white).

shortcuts.Ctrl+Z: Undo — press multiple times for multiple undos. Do NOT screenshot after pressing.
shortcuts.Alt+Tab: Switch windows / bring Paint to front

post.summary: Save the painting to a file

steps: Press Ctrl+S
If Save As dialog appears: navigate to desired folder
Triple-click the 'File name' field to select all existing text, then type new filename
If triple-click fails: click field + press Ctrl+A, then type filename
Verify 'Save as type' is PNG
Click Save button ONCE and wait for dialog to close

commonIssues.filenameNotChanging: Field was not properly selected — triple-click the field again before typing
commonIssues.saveButtonDisabled: Invalid filename characters — use only letters and numbers
commonIssues.dialogNotClosing: Wait 2-3 seconds after clicking Save before taking any action

x-agent-instructions.verification: Window title changes to '<filename> - Paint' when save succeeds. Take ONE screenshot to confirm.

fieldSelection: Triple-click filename field to select all existing text
If triple-click fails: click field + Ctrl+A
Type new filename immediately after selection
x-agent-instructions.sequence: Triple-click filename field → type name → verify PNG format → click Save ONCE → wait for close

commonIssues.filenameNotChanging: Field was not properly selected — try triple-click again
commonIssues.saveButtonDisabled: Invalid filename characters — use only letters/numbers
commonIssues.dialogNotClosing: Wait 2-3 seconds after clicking Save — do not click again

post.summary: Recover from stuck states and unexpected dialogs

steps: 1. Press Escape to close any open dialog
2. Press Alt+Tab to bring Paint to front
3. Take ONE screenshot to assess current state (counts against budget)
4. If canvas zoom is wrong: View tab → click '100%'
5. Resume from the last successfully completed step
x-agent-instructions.editColorsDialog: If the Edit Colors dialog appears (color spectrum, RGB sliders, hex field): press Escape IMMEDIATELY. Do not click anything inside it.

screenshotBudgetEnforcement.taskFailureCondition: Exceeding the screenshot budget is an AUTOMATIC TASK FAILURE regardless of drawing quality.
mandatoryCountingProtocol: Before EVERY screenshot, you MUST state: 'Screenshot count check: I have taken X screenshots so far. My budget is Y. Taking this will be X+1 of Y.'
If X+1 > Y, you MUST state: 'BUDGET EXCEEDED — NOT TAKING SCREENSHOT' and continue without taking it.
Maintain a running count in every response where a screenshot is considered.
screenshotBudgetEnforcement.rule: You have a MAXIMUM screenshot budget specified in each task. EVERY screenshot counts against this budget. Exceeding the budget means you have FAILED the task regardless of drawing quality.
takeScreenshotAfter: Launching Paint and maximizing the window (to establish canvas coordinates) — Screenshot #1
Completing ALL elements of the entire drawing — not individual elements or phases — Screenshot #2
Save confirmed (window title shows filename) — Screenshot #3
neverScreenshotAfter: Clicking a tool icon — tool selections are reliable, trust them
Clicking a color swatch — color selections are reliable, trust them
Setting a dropdown (Fill, Outline, Size) — dropdown settings are reliable, trust them
Drawing a single element when more elements remain in the same batch
Clicking outside to finalize a shape
screenshotBudgetEnforcement.trustPredictableActions: Tool selections, color selections, and dropdown settings always work. Do NOT verify them with screenshots. Proceed directly to the next action after any UI interaction.
screenshotBudgetEnforcement.violationIndicator: More than 3 screenshots total means you are screenshotting too often — task is FAILED.

actionBatching.coreRule: Complete entire workflows without intermediate verification screenshots. Trust all UI actions.
actionBatching.trustUIActions: Tool selections, color selections, and dropdown settings are reliable predictable operations. Do NOT screenshot to verify any of them.

mandatoryBatches.launchPaint: Search → click Paint → screenshot to check canvas
mandatoryBatches.toolSetup: Select tool → set Color 1 → set Color 2 → set Fill/Outline options → THEN draw (no screenshot between setup steps)
mandatoryBatches.drawShape: Click start → drag to end → release → click outside → THEN optionally screenshot only if entire drawing is complete
mandatoryBatches.drawMultipleSimilarShapes: Select tool → set colors/options ONCE → draw shape 1 → draw shape 2 → draw shape 3 → ... → click outside ONCE after last shape → THEN optionally screenshot only if entire drawing is complete
mandatoryBatches.exampleLegs: Select Line tool → set black Color 1 → draw leg 1 → draw leg 2 → draw leg 3 → draw leg 4 → click outside once — NO screenshots between or after individual legs until ALL drawing is complete
mandatoryBatches.fillArea: Select fill tool → click swatch → click canvas area → THEN screenshot only if this completes the drawing phase
mandatoryBatches.undoRetry: Ctrl+Z → fix state → redraw (no screenshot between)
mandatoryBatches.saveDialog: Triple-click filename field → type name → verify PNG → click Save ONCE → wait for close → THEN screenshot (#3) to confirm

actionBatching.antiPattern: Do NOT treat each line/shape/element as a separate phase requiring its own screenshot. Do NOT screenshot after selecting a tool. Do NOT screenshot after setting a color. Group all similar elements (all legs, all windows, all clouds) into a single batch.

beforeShapes: Color 1 set to intended outline color?
Color 2 set to intended fill color?
Fill dropdown set correctly (Solid color vs No fill)?
beforeFill: Color 1 set to desired fill color?
toolStateChecklist.recoveryOrder: If state is wrong: set colors FIRST → set tool options SECOND → select tool THIRD → draw LAST

editColorsDialogOpened.cause: Clicked 'Edit colors' button instead of a color swatch
editColorsDialogOpened.prevention: Click only within the 30-swatch grid area, not near the 'Edit colors' button below it
editColorsDialogOpened.recovery: Press Escape IMMEDIATELY. Do not interact with any field inside the dialog.

wrongDrawingLocation.prevention: Plan all coordinates from canvas_left/top/width/height before drawing anything
wrongDrawingLocation.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z immediately. Do not click again first.

colorLeakOnFill.cause: Boundary has a gap — fill flooded larger area than intended
colorLeakOnFill.prevention: Ensure all shape outlines are fully closed before filling
colorLeakOnFill.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z immediately. Find the gap, close it with pencil/line tool, then fill again.

wrongToolSelected.cause: Clicked wrong tool icon in ribbon
wrongToolSelected.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z to undo. Click the correct tool, then redraw.

shapeNotFinalized.cause: Shape still has selection handles — not yet committed
shapeNotFinalized.recovery: Click on an empty canvas area (away from the shape) to finalize/deselect.

unexpectedDialog.cause: Accidental click on a menu or button that opens a dialog
unexpectedDialog.recovery: Press Escape to dismiss. Do not interact with dialog contents.

saveDialogFilenameNotChanging.cause: File name field was not properly selected before typing
saveDialogFilenameNotChanging.recovery: Triple-click the filename field again to select all text, then type the desired filename.

saveDialogNotClosing.cause: Save operation is processing or an error occurred
saveDialogNotClosing.recovery: Wait 2-3 seconds. Do not click Save again. Do not take a screenshot yet.

excessiveScreenshots.cause: Agent verifying predictable UI actions with screenshots
excessiveScreenshots.prevention: Trust all tool selections, color selections, and dropdown settings — never screenshot to verify them
excessiveScreenshots.recovery: Stop taking screenshots immediately. Count remaining budget. Continue drawing without verification screenshots.

drawingStrategy: 1. Fill background first (entire canvas with sky color)
4. Add medium details (door, window, tree trunk)
5. Add small details and accents last

coordinatePlanning.description: After the launch screenshot, note canvas top-left corner and dimensions from the status bar. Plan ALL coordinates before drawing — do not discover coordinates by trial and error.
coordinatePlanning.typicalLayout: On a typical 1920x1080 window, canvas top-left is ~(80, 150) and canvas is ~1100x700 pixels.
coordinatePlanning.planningStep: From the launch screenshot: identify canvas_left, canvas_top, canvas_width, canvas_height. Derive ALL element coordinates from these values before drawing anything.
